Usage: spec-driven-steroids|sds [options] [command]

Inject Spec-Driven standards into your repository

Options:
  -V, --version                 output the version number
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Commands:
  validate                      Validate Spec-Driven specs for correctness and completeness.
  
  The validate command checks specs in .specs/changes/<slug>/ for:
    • structure   - Required files for brief or full lanes
    • brief       - Compact change brief structure and traceability
    • requirements - EARS patterns, REQ-X numbering, acceptance criteria
    • design      - Mermaid diagrams, DES-X numbering, _Implements tags
    • tasks       - Phase structure, task status, traceability links
    • spec        - Cross-file validation and traceability matrix
    • all         - Aggregate every spec in .specs/changes
  
  All subcommands support --format <text|json> for output control.
  Use --help with any subcommand for specific options and examples.
  doctor [options]              Check installed SDS files for missing or
                                modified artifacts
  repair [options]              Re-inject missing files for manifest-tracked
                                installs
  uninstall [options]           Remove manifest-tracked SDS files for a
                                platform and scope
  templates [options] <action>  Inspect the resolved template source
  inject [options]              Inject platform-specific Spec-Driven configs
  clean [options]               Remove globally injected Spec-Driven Steroids
  package [options]             Render the portable Agent Plugin package and
                                the marketplace catalogs
  help [command]                display help for command
